lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in quasi-linear horizontal trajectories posterior to the branchial region, with varying inter-centroid distances across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal spot rows, creating a low-contrast rectangular grid pattern across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the superior third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of small, yellow-pigmented teleost fish is positioned over the lower branchial region and the proximal base of the pectoral fin.
